name: Frontend
description: Static chat SPA and Streamlit client that render sessions, citations, and uploads and call the FastAPI backend for retrieval, search, and model replies.

name: API Layer
description: FastAPI application that exposes session, document, RAG retrieval, web-search, and health routes, plus the Python HTTP client for those endpoints.

name: API Schemas
description: Pydantic request and response models for sessions, messages, document upload, RAG retrieval, web search, and health checks, including the legacy chat schemas.

name: Service Layer
description: LangGraph chat agent and the retrieval pipeline that parse documents, embed and rerank chunks with Cohere, persist per-user FAISS indexes, and query Tavily.

name: Data Layer
description: SQLAlchemy engine, session dependency, and ORM models for chat sessions, messages, and indexed documents, plus the placeholder for on-disk runtime data.

name: Configuration
description: Runtime settings for paths, model catalogs, RAG chunking, and API keys, with the environment template, Pipenv manifest, and graph language setting.

name: Infrastructure
description: Uvicorn process declaration for Render or Railway and the Dev Container that installs dependencies and starts FastAPI and Streamlit.

name: Documentation
description: Getting-started guide covering layout, setup, FastAPI endpoints, and the LangGraph router workflow, together with the Python package list.
